title.zh: 小屏触控与音源面板可读性修复
title.en: Touch targets on phones, and a readable instrument chooser

highlights.zh: 手机上的静音、独奏、删除与加轨等控件改为 44px 命中区，且不改变轨道行高。
highlights.en: Mute, solo, remove and add-track controls now offer a 44px hit area on phones without changing the track row height.

highlights.zh: 换音源面板补上不透明表面，分类与乐器行不再压在编排画布的文字上。
highlights.en: The instrument chooser declares its own surface, so its categories and rows no longer overlap the arrangement behind them.

highlights.zh: 修复轨道行高取值缺失时的回退，避免个别浏览器下头列与数据列错位。
highlights.en: A missing track-height variable now falls back to its design value, so the header and lane columns cannot drift apart.
